## Desenho

Cada repetição separa aproximadamente 20% dos indivíduos para validação externa.
Os 80% restantes formam T100. Os treinamentos são aninhados:

\[
T_{25}\subset T_{50}\subset T_{75}\subset T_{100}.
\]

```{r splits}
assert_file("output/01_data_objects.rds")
obj <- readRDS("output/01_data_objects.rds")
n <- obj$n

PROP_VALIDACAO <- 0.20
PROPORCOES <- c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)
N_REP <- 30
SEEDS_REP <- 101 * seq_len(N_REP)

N_VALIDACAO <- round(n * PROP_VALIDACAO)
N_POOL <- n - N_VALIDACAO

splits_mestre <- setNames(
  lapply(PROPORCOES, function(x) vector("list", N_REP)),
  as.character(PROPORCOES)
)

for (v in seq_len(N_REP)) {
  set.seed(SEEDS_REP[v])

  valid <- sort(sample(seq_len(n), N_VALIDACAO, replace = FALSE))
  pool <- setdiff(seq_len(n), valid)
  perm <- sample(pool, length(pool), replace = FALSE)

  sizes <- c(
    floor(0.25 * length(pool)),
    floor(0.50 * length(pool)),
    floor(0.75 * length(pool)),
    length(pool)
  )

  for (i in seq_along(PROPORCOES)) {
    prop <- PROPORCOES[i]
    train <- sort(perm[seq_len(sizes[i])])
    splits_mestre[[as.character(prop)]][[v]] <- list(
      treino = train,
      valid = valid,
      pool = sort(pool),
      seed = SEEDS_REP[v]
    )
  }
}

for (v in seq_len(N_REP)) {
  t25 <- splits_mestre[["0.25"]][[v]]$treino
  t50 <- splits_mestre[["0.5"]][[v]]$treino
  t75 <- splits_mestre[["0.75"]][[v]]$treino
  t100 <- splits_mestre[["1"]][[v]]$treino
  valid <- splits_mestre[["1"]][[v]]$valid

  stopifnot(all(t25 %in% t50), all(t50 %in% t75), all(t75 %in% t100))
  stopifnot(length(intersect(t100, valid)) == 0)
  stopifnot(length(valid) == N_VALIDACAO)
}

saveRDS(splits_mestre, "output/02_splits_mestre_30rep.rds")

summary_splits <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(N_REP), function(v) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(PROPORCOES, function(p) {
    s <- splits_mestre[[as.character(p)]][[v]]
    data.frame(
      repeticao = v,
      proporcao_pool = p,
      n_treino = length(s$treino),
      n_validacao = length(s$valid),
      n_pool = length(s$pool),
      seed = s$seed
    )
  }))
}))
write.csv(summary_splits, "results/02_splits_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
head(summary_splits, 8)
```

Tamanhos esperados por repetição: validação = 276, T100 = 1103,
T25 = 275, T50 = 551 e T75 = 827.
